date_note: Intrusion detected on 9 November per Escudo Digital; published 19 November, which is the date used.
title: GAME says cyberattack exposed customer contact details and order history
summary: Spanish video game retailer GAME says it suffered a cyberattack and that attackers could access customer numbers, phone numbers, email addresses and order history. GAME says passwords and bank details were not compromised. Escudo Digital reports the intrusion was detected on 9 November and that the number of people affected has not been disclosed; no group has claimed it.
plain: Spanish game retailer GAME says hackers could see customers' contact details and what they bought. It says passwords and bank details were not taken.
exec: A retailer with a loyalty programme of more than 4.5 million members, per Escudo Digital, has had customer data exposed; expect phishing aimed at its customers.
action: GAME customers: change your account password, and treat unexpected emails, SMS or calls mentioning GAME or past orders as suspicious.

validation.note: Only Escudo Digital read, relaying GAME's own statement; no second publisher or GAME notice read. Reports of drained balances are unanswered by GAME.

review.note: Compared title, data types, passwords and bank details not compromised, 9 Nov detection, undisclosed count, 4.5M members, no claimant against Escudo Digital (19 Nov); GAME position paraphrased, single_source correct
